description: The image displays a series of three pie charts, labeled "easy," "medium," and a third with a partially obscured title, representing the distribution of four distinct categories, with the text "Zero-Shot" visible below the middle chart. A legend positioned on the right side of the image identifies the four categories and their corresponding colors: N+K+ in teal, N-K+ in yellow, N-K- in light orange, and N+K- in dark orange. Each of the three pie charts contains exactly four slices, with exact percentage labels displayed directly inside each segment. In the "easy" chart, the slices appear ordered by descending size clockwise starting from the top left: N+K+ (55.4%), N-K+ (38.3%), N-K- (4.6%), and N+K- (1.7%). The "medium" chart follows a similar visual distribution, containing N+K+ (58.8%), N-K+ (35.4%), N-K- (4.0%), and N+K- (1.8%). The third chart displays a different distribution, containing N-K- at 37.9%, N-K+ at 37.3%, N+K+ at 18.1%, and N+K- at 6.7%. None of the slices in any of the charts are visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding.
